banks.title: Listening GT Section 4: Ceramah Beternak Lebah di Kota

questions.prompt: How did the speaker first become interested in beekeeping?
questions.explanation_id: Ia tidak tumbuh di pertanian; tetangganya memintanya "to look after her hives while she was away".
options: She grew up on a farm
She looked after a neighbor's hives
She attended a talk at the library
She read a book about bees
correct_answers: She looked after a neighbor's hives

questions.prompt:
Complete the notes. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER.

In summer, one hive may contain up to ________ bees.
questions.explanation_id: Di musim dingin sekitar 10.000 lebah, tetapi di musim panas "a single hive can contain up to sixty thousand".

questions.prompt: City hives often produce more honey because of the variety of ________ in parks and gardens.
questions.explanation_id: Alasannya adalah "the sheer variety of flowering plants in parks, gardens, and along streets".

questions.prompt: The biggest danger for rooftop hives is strong ________.
questions.explanation_id: Panas juga masalah, tetapi "the biggest danger on a rooftop is strong wind".

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of each piece of equipment?
questions.explanation_id: Smoker "calms the bees", veil "protects your face", dan hive tool dipakai "to separate the frames".

questions.prompt: Choose TWO letters. According to the speaker, which TWO are the biggest challenges for urban beekeepers?
questions.explanation_id: Dua tantangan terbesar menurut pembicara: tetangga yang khawatir tersengat dan "finding a reliable source of water". Penyakit dan pencurian sarang jarang menjadi masalah.

questions.prompt: A good beginners' course lasts about ________ weeks.
questions.explanation_id: Kursus pemula yang baik "lasts about eight weeks".

questions.prompt: Start-up cost (hive, equipment and bees): roughly $________
questions.explanation_id: Biaya awal: "roughly four hundred dollars on a hive, the basic equipment, and your first colony".

questions.prompt: In spring and summer, inspect the hive once a ________.
questions.explanation_id: Saran pembicara: "inspecting your hive once a week" selama musim semi dan panas.

questions.prompt: What does the City Beekeepers Association offer new members?
questions.explanation_id: Asosiasi tidak memberi sarang gratis atau menjual madu, tetapi "they do run an excellent mentoring scheme".
